decision: The same checkpoint and guard are semantically and token-exact across three fresh host initializations. The reproducibility gate passes after prospectively excluding only the measured duration field that caused V499's preserved formal failure. CPU throughput, TTFT, RSS, and active-memory certification is now open.
phase2_external_blocker: 21000 blinded judgments from three independent human raters remain unavailable and are not waived.
claim_boundary: Three-host development reproducibility pass; CPU runtime, final quality, minimum information, Phase 3, and superiority remain unproven.
